ruleDefinitions.name: AA
ruleDefinitions.text: May engage aircraft and helicopters. It cannot target ground units.

ruleDefinitions.name: AA-high
ruleDefinitions.text: May engage aircraft, including fighters on Combat Air Patrol. It cannot engage helicopters or ground targets.

ruleDefinitions.name: Ambush
ruleDefinitions.text: May start on Ambush Fire in addition to other units so deployed. The Ambush Fire order is free, but other orders cost as usual.

ruleDefinitions.name: Amphibious
ruleDefinitions.text: Can cross impassable water, treating the water as dangerous terrain.

ruleDefinitions.name: Behind Enemy Lines
ruleDefinitions.text: Deploys after both sides’ other Forward Screen units and may deploy anywhere on Ambush Fire. Enemies cannot fire at it on turns 1 and 2 unless it fires first.

ruleDefinitions.name: Air Spotter
ruleDefinitions.text: May reroll a Gunship counter roll or an Airborne Reinforcement Request roll.

ruleDefinitions.name: Ambulance
ruleDefinitions.text: Can embark a destroyed infantry stand awaiting evacuation. Taking it off the friendly edge returns one BR counter of the player’s choice.

ruleDefinitions.name: Bridging
ruleDefinitions.text: May use the bridge construction rules with an Engineering order.

ruleDefinitions.name: Communications
ruleDefinitions.text: Reroll one failed off-table mortar or artillery communication test each turn. A test cannot be rerolled twice and the reroll spends no order.

ruleDefinitions.name: Dug-in
ruleDefinitions.text: Begins in reinforced cover with a 3+ Cover Save and loses that cover if it moves.

ruleDefinitions.name: Engineer
ruleDefinitions.text: May use the Engineering order.

ruleDefinitions.name: Electronic Warfare
ruleDefinitions.text: Once per game for one order, halve the enemy’s next orders total, rounding up, or make their next Reinforcement Request require a 6 without rerolls or other assistance.
ruleDefinitions.source: NORTHAG p.52; official v9, PDF p.6

ruleDefinitions.name: Forward Deployed
ruleDefinitions.text: May set up as far as halfway across the table during Forward Screen deployment.

ruleDefinitions.name: Ground Surveillance Radar
ruleDefinitions.text: A deployed radar may guide one mortar or artillery strike per turn, excluding multiple rocket launchers. The strike starts Accurate and may reroll misses on the barrage accuracy table.

ruleDefinitions.name: Helicopter
ruleDefinitions.text: Moves up to 60 inches over terrain and may hover. Apply the Air Power chapter’s helicopter rules.

ruleDefinitions.name: Infantry
ruleDefinitions.text: The team is represented by one stand. It may be targeted with Suppressing Fire; Aimed Fire cannot target it.

ruleDefinitions.name: Officer
ruleDefinitions.text: Adds one to the side’s Command and Control roll.

ruleDefinitions.name: Senior Officer
ruleDefinitions.text: Counts as an Officer and can reroll one Command and Control die once per game.

ruleDefinitions.name: Resupply
ruleDefinitions.text: Can rearm up to three eligible missile vehicles or infantry teams per game. Both units must remain in contact for a turn without other orders. Helicopters are excluded.

ruleDefinitions.name: Traffic Control
ruleDefinitions.text: Provides one reroll per game for an eligible Armour, Infantry, Anti-Tank, Anti-Aircraft or Engineer request while the Military Police unit is on the table.

ruleDefinitions.name: Sniper
ruleDefinitions.text: Sniper fire treats infantry as in the open, with a best Cover Save of 6+. Suppressing the sniper requires observing it first. Its loss draws no BR counter.

ruleDefinitions.name: Scout
ruleDefinitions.text: Counts toward the side’s Scout total for scenario setup and out-scouting.

ruleDefinitions.name: Scout (2)
ruleDefinitions.text: Counts as two Scouts. Other Scout rules apply as usual.

ruleDefinitions.name: Scout (3)
ruleDefinitions.text: Counts as three Scouts. Other Scout rules apply as usual.

ruleDefinitions.name: Mortar Spotter
ruleDefinitions.text: Provides the spotter required to use off-table mortar batteries.

ruleDefinitions.name: Mine Clearance
ruleDefinitions.text: This vehicle is listed as a mine-clearing engineering asset.

ruleDefinitions.name: ATGM
ruleDefinitions.text: Use the mounted missile profile for anti-tank guided missile fire, including its minimum range and listed ammunition.

ruleDefinitions.name: No Indirect Fire
ruleDefinitions.text: An on-table 2S1 may use Suppressing Fire or Aimed Fire with its HE shells.

ruleDefinitions.name: KMT Mine Plough
ruleDefinitions.text: The chosen tank carries the KMT mine plough upgrade.
